1uuuqr3.description_en:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives.
People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.
I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills.
Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].
Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
1uuuqr3.description_zh:
首先，请允许我介绍一下我自己。夸张点儿说，我做的是人命的活计。

有人要杀人，就会来找我，而我会雇佣一个完美的杀手。这种方式对所有人来说都安全，因为没有人知道对方是谁，就我们这活儿的性质来说再好不过了。

最近我听说你的手艺不错，能担得起这活儿，这说法到底对不对，我觉得值得一试。

你要是有兴趣给我做事儿，那就展示下你传说中的身手吧。

目标是 [TARGET]，他们在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，悄悄得杀掉他们。

办成了，你不仅有钱可拿，而且也是你实力的证明，以后还会有活儿给你。

此致，
沃恩

1gi5ae5.description_en:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.
Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at [LOCATION]. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.
You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.
When you’re done, take the stuff to [DESTINATION] and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

你有没有过那种感觉——问别人问题时，明明觉得他在撒谎，可你还是选择信他一回？对，我现在就处在这种状况。

可能会有几个捡破烂的在那边晃荡，不过我觉得你应付起来应该不费劲。

搞定之后，把货送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，报酬少不了你的。

- 刺痛

197qgdu.description_en:
Hey,
Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.
Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.
Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
197qgdu.description_zh:
嘿，

需要找个靠谱的承包商帮我们解个围。

我们一个运输员半道撂挑子了，客户那批货现在卡在半路上。估计是想跟我们重新谈判个更高价，但这可不是玲家快递的作风。反正人已经跑路了，我们急着把这单收尾。

佩特拉和我跟这客户合作好多年了，关系一直挺稳，真不想因为一个不靠谱的运输员全砸了。你能去 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 把货取走吗？记得带个<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，再开艘能装下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱</EM4>的船。

货送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 那边的货运电梯就行，我们马上结账。真挺感谢你搭把手的，客户肯定也一样！

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

Hey,
Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist Dr. Logan Jorrit. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered Onyx Facility where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist. Once there, locate and access the research lab’s personnel files so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.
Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.
While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.
I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there.
Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.
1vzg6hw.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
一位客户请求霍克罗事务所为臭名昭著的科学家<EM4>洛根·约里特博士</EM4>编纂一份完整的卷宗。洛根博士被认为对发生在联合科学与开发公司拉撒路站点的事件负有责任，客户迫切希望更全面地了解洛根博士及其研究内容。

合约调查员的行动：
进入 ASD 已经关闭的<EM4>玛瑙设施</EM4>，洛根博士曾是该设施的首席科学家。到达后，找到并<EM4>访问研究实验室的人事档案</EM4>，以便我们能大致了解那里曾经发生的事情。

虽然 ASD 已正式关闭该设施，但仍需保持警惕。不仅实验室本身可能存在危险，周围区域也显示出近期有人活动的迹象。可能会有拾荒者或擅闯人员在现场。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.
